# LinkedIn Draft - 2026-09-15

A permissionless Android app can obtain root on current Samsung, Xiaomi, Oppo and OnePlus flagships via a page use-after-free in OEM kernel drivers, defeating verified boot and locked bootloaders.

Went through 40 links today. Here's what made the brief:

1. OEMpocalypse: unprivileged Android app gets root on Samsung, Xiaomi, Oppo, OnePlus
   Changes a practical security assumption for anyone shipping mobile apps or relying on device attestation.

2. Nari Labs open-sources a Qwen3-TTS/ASR inference engine and claims #1 accuracy on Coval benchmarks
   Directly actionable cost/latency lever for voice-agent projects such as CalenCall.

3. Ollama v0.34.1: MLX memory-pressure handling and prefix-cache eviction fixes
   Fixes a real failure mode (memory pressure and silent truncation) for Mac-local model serving.

4. Composio CLI cuts 221ms and 44MB RSS off every invocation
   Per-invocation overhead matters when an agent shells out to the CLI repeatedly.

5. We are all Product Engineers now
   Useful positioning frame for a one-person shop deciding where to spend attention.
